title: Sniper Tour - UTV Ride & Shoot Combo
includes: Transportation to and from our facility (not included)
No deposits. We hold your ID and credit/debit card during your rental (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Combine thrilling off-road rides with a unique long-range shooting experience in the stunning Bradshaw Mountains. The Sniper Recon UTV Tour takes you through rugged terrain to a private 500-yard shooting range. Guided by expert instructors, you’ll shoot iconic rifles like the Ruger Precision Rifle and Barrett Model 99 at steel targets up to 500 yards away. This adventure is designed for all skill levels, ensuring everyone feels confident while aiming for precision. Enjoy breathtaking views and a mix of adrenaline and skill as you embark on this unforgettable outing.

- Duration: 3-hour tour
- Shoot two iconic rifles: Ruger Precision Rifle (.308 Win) and Barrett Model 99 (.50 BMG)
- Expert guidance from certified instructors for all shooting levels
- Minimum age of 18+
